overview_description.description: Wordsmith AI develops artificial intelligence software for in-house legal teams, helping them manage legal work, review documents, conduct research, and respond to legal requests within existing business workflows. The platform uses AI agents trained on an organization's contracts, policies, playbooks, and internal knowledge to assist with tasks such as contract drafting, document review, legal guidance, and matter triage. Wordsmith integrates with tools such as email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Word, and document repositories, allowing legal teams to access information and complete work without switching between multiple systems. The platform also provides workflow automation, audit trails, and reporting capabilities that support legal operations and oversight. Its products are designed for corporate legal departments seeking to handle routine legal processes internally while maintaining human review for decisions that require professional judgment.
